questions.question: Whom does God present in Isaiah 42, the first 'Servant Song'?
options: My king, who rules with an iron rod
My servant, my chosen, in whom I delight
My enemy, whom I will surely destroy
My prophet, sent to warn all of the nations
questions.answer: My servant, my chosen, in whom I delight

questions.question: How gentle is this servant described as being?
options: A mighty and dreadful warrior who tramples all of his foes beneath his feet
A great consuming fire that utterly devours all of the wicked of the earth
A bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not quench
A loud and ceaseless voice that cries out aloud in all of the city streets
questions.answer: A bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not quench
